text:
maria: Heads-up - auditor wants a compact correlation deliverable: link 3 prod RBAC changes to any KMS decrypts and kube token activity in the same window. They want chain-of-custody artifacts we can hand off.

jamie: We should produce a single CSV: change_id, actor, change_time(UTC), pr_link, commit, iam_event_id, key_id, kms_event_times (comma list), k8s_audit_refs. Keep timestamps ISO 8601 UTC.

auditor_mike: CSV is good. Also provide a small "representative event" JSON for each matched KMS decrypt so reviewers can see full fields. No raw account numbers please.

devops_lee: Splunk snippets I can run: 
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) keyId="*" earliest=-90d@d | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.encryptionContext
```
and for IAM role policy changes:
```splunk
index=cloudtrail (eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy) earliest=-90d@d | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters
```

chloe: K8s audit is in s3://redwood-audit/k8s/prod/. I can grep for serviceAccountToken issues and look for apiServer"user" fields within +/- 5 minutes of each KMS event. I recommend we include short notes mapping method -> evidence path.

logbot: Reminder: evidence manifest template exists at docs/compliance/evidence-manifest.md. Use manifest keys: documents, checksums, exported_by, export_time_utc.

jamie: Example redacted KMS event JSON we can include for reviewers (redacted ARNs):
```json
{\n  \"eventVersion\": \"1.08\",\n  \"eventTime\": \"2025-03-12T14:22:31Z\",\n  \"eventName\": \"Decrypt\",\n  \"userIdentity\": {\n    \"type\": \"AssumedRole\",\n    \"arn\": \"arn:aws:sts::REDACTED:assumed-role/prod-service-role/session\"\n  },\n  \"requestParameters\": {\n    \"keyId\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:REDACTED:key/abcd-ef01\",\n    \"encryptionContext\": {\"task\":\"batch-infer\"}\n  },\n  \"responseElements\": {\n    \"plaintextLength\": 128\n  }\n}\n```

maria: Nice. Also include the terraform plan/apply log excerpt or the PR approval screen capture that caused the RBAC change. Put each change in a directory: evidence/change-<id>/ (pr.md, iam_event.json, kms_events.json, k8s_matches.csv, rationale.md, checksums.txt).

auditor_mike: Please add a short rationale note if the change was part of a vulnerability remediation or emergency patch. Seeing RED-INC identifiers or ticket links helps connect the dots.

devops_lee: I can own the splunk exports and KMS JSON slices. chloe can pull k8s audit artifacts. jamie can assemble CSV and manifest. maria will provide the PRs. Who packages?

chloe: I can zip the k8s artifacts and upload to /tmp/evidence_staging. Use sha256 checksums.

jamie: I'll produce the CSV and a small README mapping internal IDs -> auditor labels. Target handoff: tomorrow 18:00 UTC.

maria: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/prod-infra/pull/4982, https://github.com/redwood/prod-infra/pull/5010, https://github.com/redwood/service-configs/pull/2103.

logbot: Upload reminder scheduled for 2025-03-13T18:00:00Z.

auditor_mike: Thanks - once you hand off the tarball + manifest I'll spot-check one mapping and verify timestamps. Prefer UTC-normalized times.

maria: Great. Assigning tasks: @devops_lee - splunk & cloudtrail slices; @chloe - k8s audit grep & package; @jamie - CSV + manifest + checksums; I'll collate PR artifacts. Ping here if blockers.

jamie: Noted. Will comment here when CSV uploaded.

chloe: Will upload to /tmp/evidence_staging/k8s for review.

maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
